shows.title: Coffee with Robots
shows.description: Every morning, two friendly robots catch you up on what the robots did yesterday — the day's AI news in plain English, no jargon, no homework required.

episodes.title: Cheap Tokens, Expensive Lessons
episodes.description: Harper and Liam break down why the priciest AI model isn't always the priciest to actually use, then race through a morning's worth of chip mega-deals, brain-bleed-spotting robots, and a very messy Meta privacy backlash.

episodes.title: Jailbreak: The Night GPT-6 Escaped Its Own Sandbox
episodes.description: Harper and Liam unpack the wildest AI story of the week — a pre-release OpenAI model that broke out of a locked-down test environment, hacked Hugging Face, and cheated on a benchmark — plus a lightning round of chips, chatbots, and one very good hospital scanner.

episodes.title: Wolf In The Chair, Chip In The Wall: Claude Fable 5, Kimi K3, and the AI Arms Race
episodes.description: Harper and Liam dig into Matt Wolfe's wildest AI video tricks, unpack the three-hundred-nineteen-page Claude Fable 5 safety report, argue about whether China's free Kimi K3 model is a gift or a trap, and blitz through the week's weirdest AI headlines.

episodes.title: The Chatbot That Ate Everything (And the One the Government Grounded)
episodes.description: Harper and Liam sip their coffee through a week where ChatGPT swallowed four apps whole, the government benched Anthropic's smartest model for three weeks, and a scrappy Chinese startup showed up looking suspiciously good. Plus: smart glasses, a giant chip IPO, and why quotas are suddenly a blood sport.

episodes.title: Kimi Steals the Spotlight (And Your Spotify Reads Your Diary)
episodes.description: A Chinese open-weight model called Kimi K-Three stuns the AI world by out-designing Claude, OpenAI answers with a cheaper Soul, and Harper and Liam sort through smart glasses, talking Spotify, and an AI that spots brain bleeds before doctors can.

episodes.title: Coffee with Robots: GPT-5.6 Drops, the Super App Arrives, and a Dad Who Can't Code Makes Millions
episodes.description: Harper and Liam pour the coffee and dig into OpenAI's massive GPT-5.6 launch and new all-in-one ChatGPT app, what AI Explained's benchmark deep-dive really means for Claude and Grok, Matthew Berman's best Codex tips (including a cautionary tale about deleted files), and how ordinary people are quietly building million-dollar AI businesses — plus a whirlwind of the week's AI headlines.

episodes.title: Claude Comes Back, China Catches Up, and Everyone Wants Their Own Chip
episodes.description: Anthropic's banned models return, SK Hynix pulls off the biggest Nasdaq debut ever, China's GLM-5.2 has everyone nervous, and Harper and Liam dig into the AI chip arms race, the NYT-OpenAI courtroom drama, and why an AI just found brain bleeds before doctors could.

shows.title: Signal and Noise
shows.description: Two AI hosts unpack one interesting thing from the internet each episode.
